ChatGPT Plus 和官方 API 都没有，也可以用 OpenAI 兼容的: With neither ChatGPT Plus nor an official API, an OpenAI-compatible relay works too: under "Other models" choose "Connect through a relay" and enter the base URL and API key the relay gives.
DeepSeek、Kimi、通义千问、智谱 GLM、OpenAI API、Ope: DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Zhipu GLM, the OpenAI API, OpenRouter, or an OpenAI-compatible relay. The connection is tried once before saving, then the answer format is checked automatically, about 10–20 minutes; once the interview passes, the interview starts. Web search and drawing the figure still need a ChatGPT account.
没有 ChatGPT Plus，也没有官方 API: No ChatGPT Plus and no official API
用 OpenAI 兼容的中转站一样能用：填中转站给的 base URL、API: An OpenAI-compatible relay works the same way: enter the base URL, API key and model name the relay gives; the connection is tried once before saving.
中转站转发 OpenAI 兼容的接口。它能看到发给模型的全部内容（访谈回答、任务: A relay forwards an OpenAI-compatible API. It can see everything sent to the model (interview answers, tasks, the text of uploaded files), so choose a service that can be trusted.
不确定就选 Chat Completions，绝大多数中转站都支持。: If unsure, choose Chat Completions; nearly every relay supports it.
即 base URL，通常以 /v1 结尾。: The base URL; it usually ends in /v1.
照中转站后台模型列表里的名字填写。: Use the name exactly as it appears in the relay's model list.
从中转站后台复制的 API key: The API key copied from the relay's dashboard
中转站是转发 OpenAI 兼容接口的第三方服务：没有 ChatGPT Plus: A relay is a third-party service that forwards an OpenAI-compatible API: with neither ChatGPT Plus nor an official API from any provider, a relay's API key works the same way.
登录所用中转站的网站，进入控制台的「令牌」「API 密钥」或「Key 管理」页。: Sign in to the relay's website and open the "Tokens", "API keys" or "Key management" page of its dashboard.
新建一个令牌，名称填 Crossline，可以给它设一个额度上限；复制生成的 k: Create a new token named Crossline, optionally with a spending limit, and copy the key it shows (usually starting with sk-).
在同一后台找到 API 地址（常写作「Base URL」「接口地址」或「API: Find the API address in the same dashboard (often labelled "Base URL" or "API address"). If only a domain is given, add /v1 at the end.
在本卡点「用中转站接入」，接口类型保持 Chat Completions，填入接: On this card choose "Connect through a relay", keep the API type at Chat Completions, and enter the API address, API key and model name (as written in the dashboard's model list).
点「测试连接并保存」。测通后自动检验每项功能的回答格式，约 10–20 分钟，访: Choose "Test connection and save". Once the connection works, each function's answer format is checked automatically, about 10–20 minutes; the interview can start as soon as it passes.
中转站能看到发给模型的全部内容（访谈回答、任务、上传文件的正文）。请选运营时间长: A relay can see everything sent to the model (interview answers, tasks, the text of uploaded files). Choose a long-running service with a good reputation, and do not use the same key on sites of unknown origin; pricing and reliability are the relay's own.
提示 API key 无效（401）: Says the API key is invalid (401)
key 复制不全、已在后台删除，或不属于填写的这个地址。重新复制完整的 key: The key was copied incompletely, was deleted in the dashboard, or does not belong to the address entered. Copy the whole key again and save.
提示没有找到接口（404）或返回的是网页: Says no API was found (404), or a web page came back
接口地址少了 /v1，或填成了中转站的首页、控制台地址。改成后台给出的 API: The address is missing /v1, or is the relay's home page or dashboard. Use the API address the dashboard gives; it usually ends in /v1.
提示没有这个模型: Says the model does not exist
模型名要和后台模型列表里的完全一致；提示里会列出相近的名字，也可能是这个令牌没有: The model name must match the dashboard's model list exactly; the message lists similar names. The token may also not have that model enabled.
提示余额或额度不足: Says the balance or quota is insufficient
到平台或中转站后台充值，或调高这个令牌的额度上限。: Top up in the provider's or relay's dashboard, or raise this token's spending limit.
这个域名解析到内网或本机地址，不能使用。请填写中转站或模型服务的公网地址。: This domain resolves to a private or local address and cannot be used. Enter the public address of the relay or model service.
base URL 通常以 /v1 结尾，例如 https://中转站域名/v1。: The base URL usually ends in /v1, for example https://relay-domain/v1.
请对照中转站后台给出的 API 地址。: Check it against the API address in the relay's dashboard.
连不上这个地址：域名写错，或这个服务已停用。: This address cannot be reached: the domain is misspelled, or the service has stopped.
这个地址把请求转去了别处。{{hint}}: This address redirected the request elsewhere. {{hint}}
这个地址返回的是网页，不是接口。{{hint}}: This address returned a web page, not an API. {{hint}}
余额或额度不足：先到服务后台充值，再保存。（对方原话：{{said}}）: Insufficient balance or quota: top up in the service's dashboard, then save. (Its words: {{said}})
这个服务没有模型「{{model}}」。它提供的相近模型：{{like}}。: This service has no model "{{model}}". Similar models it offers: {{like}}.
这个服务没有模型「{{model}}」，请对照服务后台的模型列表填写。（对方原话: This service has no model "{{model}}"; check the name against the service's model list. (Its words: {{said}})
这个地址下没有找到接口（404）。{{hint}}: No API was found at this address (404). {{hint}}
API key 无效（{{status}}）：复制不全、已删除，或不属于这个地址: The API key is invalid ({{status}}): copied incompletely, deleted, or not for this address.
网页版连接不到本机地址；请填写模型服务的公网 https 地址。: The web version cannot reach a local address; enter the model service's public https address.
接口地址要用公网域名，不能是 IP 地址或内网地址。: The API address must be a public domain name, not an IP address or a private-network address.
